simple.meaning: צְבִיָּה (tsᵉbîyâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “a female gazelle.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: צְבִיָּה (H6646) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Song of Songs 4:5, with occurrences in Song of Solomon.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to צְבִיָּה (H6646) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in צְבִיָּה (H6646) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: צְבִיָּה (tsᵉbîyâh) / H6646 is traced through Song of Songs 4:5, Song of Songs 7:4 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
